description: Reviewed customer-facing descriptions for request fields of the treg-public declarations (Spec #1285 R1). Written by AIsa from public field names, types, enums, bounds, operation summaries and observed responses; upstream notes are never copied. by_operation entries (public operationId -> query/<name> or body/<path>) take precedence over by_name. Every entry must pass scripts/vocab_scan.py.
